$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-route-distance-and-rdw-lookup D3). Seeds the DORMANT `route-planner-openrouteservice` source that OCA\Integriq\Service\RouteDistanceService asks for the road distance between two postcodes (GET /v2/directions/{profile}?start=lon,lat&end=lon,lat). configuration.routeProvider 'openrouteservice' selects that request shape. To go live: create a credential named openrouteservice for your OpenRouteService API key (sent as the Authorization header), link the app's route planner connection to this source, and enable it.

objects.name: OpenRouteService route planner
objects.description: Answers the road distance between two places, for example for a commuting allowance. Create a credential named openrouteservice for your API key, link the app's route planner connection to this source and enable it.
